title: Sound Effect Lab UI, decision, and warning pack
description: A set of 22 short cues for UI and for a scene: decision-button confirms (12 variants), quiz right-or-wrong, clicks, warnings, a chime, and a bell that raises unease. (Count: 22) The publisher's own note for chime 1 is a sting for a letdown (confirmed on /sound/anime/ on 2026-07-31). It marks a mistake or a disappointment. The old note that it meant done or decision was wrong. [audio-standard] partial membership, 20 of 21 sounds (the standard flag on the local index.jsonl / source of truth: internal repo sfx-curation.json)
when_to_use: For a button confirm, a quiz right-or-wrong call, an operation click, or a warning. Chime 1 is only for a mistake or a letdown. Do not use it as a done or decision cue
ai_usage: 音源そのもの（波形）は改変しない。ピッチ・音量・トリム程度の加工は可。利用時は attribution_required=false を厳守し、クレジット表記は任意（つけなくてよい）。 AI学習データとしての二次利用はしない。
